verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable on GitHub: raw skill files (skills/*/SKILL.md), docs, release notes and tests are all fetchable, and a hands-on probe cloned the repo and read back plain-markdown skills. However, nothing in the evidence names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any evidence of an open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier), independent confirmation of licensing terms.
